ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.3 (TieJin Modify) RJW 泄欲对象资格与特化科技说明。 基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护，包含 2.3.2 及更早版本内容。 锁链达到第 2 阶段的 SSC 性奴可按 RJW 原有条件被指派为泄欲对象；见习性奴不因此获得资格。 各性奴特化科技介绍现列出已实现功能和经验增长方式，未完成方向明确标注状态；同步简中、繁中、英文和俄文。 旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停，宠物猫、宠物兔未完成入口继续禁用。 完整中英双语更新记录见 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from upstream 2.2.8, including 2.3.2 and earlier content. SSC sex slaves at Chain stage 2 or higher can be designated as RJW Comfort pawns under RJW's existing conditions; trainees gain no eligibility from SSC identity alone. Specialization research now explains implemented effects and experience sources and identifies unfinished paths in four languages. Legacy RimTalk remains suspended; unfinished Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices remain disabled. See CHANGELOG.md for the full Chinese and English notes.
